title: plugin-audit: two comments still say a config_change row holds only a digest, after #30923 made non-secret rows carry readable before and after values
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW

Filing gate: ① a named location, from the contract review of PR #30937 (card #30923, record 6685638224), should-fix items. ⛔ Not a claim.

PR #30937 makes a settings `config_change` audit row carry readable `old_value` and `new_value` for non-secret keys (secrets keep a placeholder), and narrows those values in `audit-log-field-redaction.ts` for a reader whose field-level security masks the settings store's `value`. Two comments in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/` still describe the old row:

1. `audit-plugin.ts` about :277-279 says the `config_change` row's digest sits next to the CRUD mirror's row "that carries the value". That now holds only for secret keys.
2. `audit-log-read-visibility.ts` about :51-58 says a `config_change` row with no `record_id` "carries no record's field values". The behaviour is still right (the redaction keys on `object_name`), but the sentence is now false.

Wanted: both comments say what the code does after #30937. Comment-only, no behaviour change, `skip-changeset`.

Suggested grade: p3, `domain:server`. Serial: after PR #30937 lands.
